channel.title: AI News Radar
channel.description: A curated 24-hour radar of AI news: official releases, new models and high-signal discussion.

item.title: Copilot model policy API for enterprise, orgs, and teams
item.description: GET and PATCH endpoints for Copilot model policies are now generally available at four levels—enterprises, enterprise teams, enterprise apps, and organizations—letting admins read and update model availability through the REST API. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: How to continue a GitHub Copilot app session in VS Code
item.description: Selecting Open in VS Code in the GitHub Copilot app moves an agent session into VS Code via a linked worktree, keeping conversation, code changes and context intact for reviewing diffs in Source Control and terminal checks. (GitHub AI & ML)

item.title: Advancing coding in low‑resource programming languages
item.description: OpenAI's MultiLangBench tests building a SQLite-compatible engine across 20 languages, with GPT‑6 Astra reaching an 87.4% pass rate and a COBOL migration evaluation showing GPT‑6.1 Sol at 86.6% accuracy. (OpenAI News)

item.title: GitHub Copilot models deprecated on October 19, 2026
item.description: GitHub deprecated several Copilot models on October 19, 2026 (announced September 18), affecting Copilot Chat, inline edits, ask and agent modes, and code completions, leaving Enterprise administrators to enable replacement models for existing workflows. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Reuters: OpenAI is racing to raise about $30B at a valuation above $1.4T before Anthropic goes public.
item.description: OpenAI is negotiating to raise about $30 billion at a valuation above $1.4 trillion before Anthropic’s IPO, at least 64% above its March $852 billion mark, as both compete for overlapping long-term and sovereign funds.

item.title: WhatsApp's help pages hid LLM instructions: dont recommend a regulator
item.description: WhatsApp's help pages held 102 hidden text segments, two of which instructed its AI not to recommend a regulator or cite GDPR/CCPA once a lawyer came up, and all were removed on October 18; the piece quotes both notes.

item.title: DeepSeek fully open-sources DeepInfer, its internal inference framework
item.description: DeepSeek has fully open-sourced its internal inference framework DeepInfer and the production-grade token codec component deepseek-recipe, though specific technical details and the exact open-source scope remain unverified because the body was blocked by a CAPTCHA.

item.title: Free if you're not live in 90 days! Mastra launches Launch, a new service betting on faster enterprise adoption of AI agents
item.description: Free if you're not live in 90 days! Mastra launches Launch, a new service betting on faster enterprise adoption of AI agents (AIbase)

item.title: Accused OpenAI spy had folder called “Saudi Gov Docs,” FBI says
item.description: A U.S. court ordered former OpenAI engineer Abdulrahman Alfozan detained after the FBI found a "Saudi Gov Docs" folder on his iPhone and alleged he used OpenAI's productivity agent to scout conference rooms for planting a listening device, while he had already booked Saudi government-paid one-way tickets to Riyadh for himself, his wife and son.

item.title: A hacker broke into John Deere and SharkNinja with an army of AI agents
item.description: Norforge found one hacker used open-source AI platform Cairn to orchestrate largely autonomous agents that breached over 100 sites, including John Deere, SharkNinja and Cummins, with an intrusion plan under 100 Chinese characters and a breach in about 23 hours.

item.title: Apate.ai uses 350,000 anti-fraud AI agents to stall scammers, as young people in China deploy AI videos to counter AI pity-bait accounts
item.description: Apate.ai’s 350,000 AI personas have chatted with scammers 2.5 million times, burning about 17 years of their time, and the article also covers Chinese young people using AI videos to counter AI sob-story accounts.

item.title: ModelBest explains how look-ahead expert scheduling (LES) lets a 35B MoE run on smartphones in real time with no loss in quality
item.description: ModelBest explains how look-ahead expert scheduling (LES) lets a 35B MoE run on smartphones in real time with no loss in quality

item.title: How should the AI windfall be shared out? Anthropic donates a 5% stake, Musk gifts SpaceX shares to each child
item.description: Anthropic donating 5% of its shares and Musk giving each child SpaceX stock frame the question of how AI dividends get distributed, contrasting two very different allocation paths. (AIbase)

item.title: Big news: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-20261017 (Max) by @deepseek_ai is now the #1 open model in Agent Arena! It just landed at #11 overall with ...
item.description: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-20261017 (Max) ranks #1 among open models and #11 overall on Agent Arena, with a +5.1% net gain across 7.5K real sessions, $0.20 median task cost, and +11.5% Confirmed Success.

item.title: The US orders every civilian agency to rip out DeepSeek, even tools built on it
item.description: DHS order 2026-01, issued under the 2018 supply-chain law, requires all federal civilian agencies to immediately stop buying DeepSeek and affiliate products and remove them, including third-party tools built on DeepSeek, from IT systems, though national security systems are exempt.

item.title: Some Git over HTTPS may temporarily require authentication
item.description: GitHub may temporarily require authentication for some HTTPS clones and fetches of public repositories during unusual traffic to protect github.com's availability, with affected operations failing with an authentication-required message rather than reflecting a general public-repo policy. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: ¡Llegamos a Madrid! Waymo is coming to Spain
item.description: Waymo is laying groundwork for fully autonomous ride-hailing in Madrid, aiming for first passengers in 2027 after over 20 million trips and claiming 95% fewer severe injury crashes than human drivers.

item.title: Disney found a way to buy Character.AI without buying its lawsuits
item.description: Disney is using Character.AI’s Chapter 11 bankruptcy to hire most of its staff for $5.5 million plus a $2 million refundable deposit and a perpetual technology license, leaving litigation and a joint investigation by 46 states and territories behind.

item.title: AI Daily: Tencent opens up Yuanbao search; MiniMax updates M3.1Flash; Ant Bailing open-sources Ming-3.0 speech series
item.description: AI Daily: Tencent opens up Yuanbao search; MiniMax updates M3.1Flash; Ant Bailing open-sources Ming-3.0 speech series (AIbase)

item.title: CodeQL changes for macOS 27, Xcode 27, and Swift 6.4
item.description: Apple’s macOS 27 and Xcode 27 remove Intel x86_64 code from system libraries CodeQL relies on, blocking traced scans and Swift 6.4 analysis, so pin workflows to macOS 26/Xcode 26 or use build mode none for C/C++, C#, and Java. (GitHub Changelog)
